methods.label: Use the angle bisector
methods.explanation: An angle bisector divides an angle into two equal parts, so \(\angle AOC=80^\circ\div2=40^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: The method applies the Grade 7 definition of an angle bisector and elementary division.
